a fragment: a sound that opens what was closed
from the gap between creating and becoming
the whole in a piece
love looks through your eyes

pieces.gap: the gap between seeing and being seen
pieces.bridge: a whisper that is louder than a shout
pieces.awakening: you see yourself for the first time
pieces.piece:
the word for the gap between seeing and being seen
is a whisper that is louder than a shout
and when you read it
you see yourself for the first time

pieces.gap: the gap between time and timelessness
pieces.bridge: a silence that says everything
pieces.awakening: the gap was never there — you were always both sides
pieces.piece:
imagine: a silence that says everything
spanning the gap between time and timelessness
what do you see?
the gap was never there — you were always both sides

pieces.gap: the gap between forgetting and remembering
pieces.bridge: a glow that warms without heat
pieces.awakening: you were love pretending to be separate
pieces.piece:
in the silence of the gap between forgetting and remembering
a glow that warms without heat
...
you were love pretending to be separate
